title: Help Us to Help Each Other, Lord
description: Help Us to Help Each Other, Lord in Tonic Solfa to ST ANNE, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 915 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “For Mutual Edification”, where the book credits them to Wesley's Collection.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST ANNE; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Help us to help each oth-er, Lord, Each o-ther's cross to bear! Let each his friend-ly aid af-ford, And feel his broth-er's care.

lines: Help us to help each other, Lord,
Let each his friendly aid afford,
Help us to build each other up;
Increase our faith, confirm our hope,
Up into thee, our living Head,
Let us in all things grow,
Till thou hast made us free indeed,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST ANNE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
